questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Dolphins or Knights?
At which ground did Boland record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl — largest win by runs of 533, against Kei on 2011/01/29.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Fours' in the 05/06 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Johmari Logtenberg holds it, with a total of 53.

questions.question: At which ground did Nadine de Klerk record their career-best innings (74, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Newlands Stadium, against Dolphins on 2025/03/23.

questions.question: At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
Excluding Western Province, which team has won the most domestic titles in this database?
questions.explanation: Dragons have won 4 titles, the most of any union other than the dominant Western Province.
